userStories.title: Create Supabase SQL schema file
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the full database schema in a SQL file so it can be applied to Supabase.
acceptanceCriteria: supabase/schema.sql contains full schema
profiles table: id (UUID PK, FK to auth.users ON DELETE CASCADE), email (TEXT NOT NULL), display_name (TEXT), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()), updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW())

user_progress table: id (UUID PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()), user_id (UUID NOT NULL FK to profiles), problem_id (TEXT NOT NULL), is_self_reported (BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE), source_url (TEXT), topics (TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}'), approach (TEXT), remarks (TEXT), code (TEXT), time_taken_mins (INTEGER), performance_score (INTEGER CHECK 1-5), time_complexity (TEXT), space_complexity (TEXT), ai_review (JSONB), next_revision_date (TIMESTAMPTZ), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()), updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW())
Trigger on_auth_user_created: AFTER INSERT on auth.users, inserts into profiles with id and email
Index idx_user_progress_revision on (user_id, next_revision_date) WHERE next_revision_date IS NOT NULL
Index idx_user_progress_user_problem on (user_id, problem_id, created_at DESC)
RLS enabled on both tables with policies: users can SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE only their own rows
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This file is for reference and manual application to Supabase SQL editor. Schema from IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.
